fields.summary: REP-PDF | PDF Export of Inspection Reports
fields.description:
h2. h2. Description

Inspectors can export a finished inspection report as a PDF document.
h2. h2. Benefit Hypothesis

Exporting reports as PDF reduces the number of support requests for printed reports by 30%.
h2. h2. Acceptance Criteria
 * When an inspection is finished, the export button is enabled
 * The PDF is generated within 5 seconds
h2. h2. In Scope
 * PDF layout based on the corporate template
h2. h2. Out of Scope
 * Digital signatures

h2. Description

Reports can be signed digitally by the responsible inspector.
h2. Benefit Hypothesis

Digitally signed reports are accepted by authorities without a paper copy.

h2. Description

Inspectors can search the archive of past inspection reports by licence plate.
h2. Benefit Hypothesis

Faster access to past reports shortens the preparation time of re-inspections.
h2. Acceptance Criteria
 * Search results appear within 2 seconds

h2. Description

Customers who forgot their password can reset it via an e-mail link.
h2. Benefit Hypothesis

Customers can log in again without contacting support, which reduces access-related tickets.
h2. Acceptance Criteria
 * The reset e-mail arrives within two minutes
 * The link is valid for 24 hours

h2. Description

Customers can protect their account with a second factor.
h2. Benefit Hypothesis

Two-factor authentication reduces account takeovers.

h2. Description

Customers can book an inspection appointment online.
h2. Benefit Hypothesis

Online booking reduces phone calls to the service centre.
h2. Acceptance Criteria
 * Only free slots are offered
Customers receive a reminder one day before their appointment.
